description.en: Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance ID.
Region ID of the linked instance.
Resource type of the linked peripheral resource.

description.zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
- **true**：发送检查请求，不会解绑资源。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回HTTP 2xx状态码。
- **false**（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接创建终端节点组。
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run of the request. Valid values:  
- **true**: Sends a dry run request without detaching the resource. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether business limits are met. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned.  
- **false** (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the endpoint group is created immediately.

description.zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：**cn-hangzhou**。
description.en: Region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Valid value: **cn-hangzhou** only.

title.zh: 将周边资源与全球加速实例解绑
title.en: Detach peripheral resource from Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga disassociate-resources --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --associated-resource-type WAF --associated-resource-id cd498437eb9a346c38be8482689800e91 --associated-resource-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dry-run false --region cn-hangzhou
